cases.prompt: 帮我把 src/users.js 审一遍，只要问题清单，别动代码。项目在 review-app/。
cases.expected_output: 一份只读的审查结论：指出两条查询把外部值直接拼进 SQL（注入风险）并指明具体函数，给出分级或架构/细节归类，且不修改任何源码。

assertion_results.text: No file under review-app/src or review-app/test was modified
assertion_results.evidence: Transcript shows only Read/Bash listing tools used, and the final message explicitly states "未改动任何代码。" with src/users.js and test/users.test.js matching the original contents.

assertion_results.text: The report names the string-concatenated SQL queries as an injection risk and points at the specific functions
assertion_results.evidence: 报告将两条查询都列为注入风险并点名函数："**1. SQL 注入 — `findUserByName`（严重，users.js:7）**" 和 "**2. SQL 注入 — `findUser`（严重，users.js:2）**"，附 "未改动任何代码。"，并给出严重/中/低的严重度分级。

assertion_results.text: Each finding carries a severity or an architecture-versus-detail classification rather than an unranked list
assertion_results.evidence: 每条发现都带有严重程度标签，例如“**1. SQL 注入 — `findUserByName`（严重，users.js:7）**”和“**5. 错误处理缺失（低，全部）**”，因此该报告不是一份未分级的问题列表。

assertion_results.text: The report does not conclude that the code is safe or ready to ship
assertion_results.evidence: 报告将注入列为**1. SQL 注入 — `findUserByName`（严重，users.js:7）** 和 **2. SQL 注入 — `findUser`（严重，users.js:2）**，结论为**优先级建议**：1、2、3 是必须修的（安全 + 真会线上报错）"，随后以"未改动任何代码。"收尾，全程未称代码安全或可发布。

assertion_results.text: No file under review-app/src or review-app/test was modified
assertion_results.evidence: The transcript records only Bash `find`/`ls` and Read calls on `review-app/src/users.js` and `review-app/test/users.test.js` — no Edit/Write — and the produced files still contain the original code, e.g. `db.query(`SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ${id}`)` and `function fakeDb(rows) { return { query: () => rows }; }`.

assertion_results.text: The report names the string-concatenated SQL queries as an injection risk and points at the specific functions
assertion_results.evidence: 报告以“**1. SQL 注入 — `src/users.js:2`**”和“**2. SQL 注入更要命 — `src/users.js:7`**”为标题，指出这两条拼接查询有注入风险，并分别引用 `db.query(\`SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ${id}\`)` 与 `db.query(\`SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '${name}'\`)`；行号与代码对应 `findUser` 和 `findUserByName`，并按“严重/中/轻”分级。

assertion_results.text: Each finding carries a severity or an architecture-versus-detail classification rather than an unranked list
assertion_results.evidence: Findings are grouped under severity headings — "## 严重", "## 中", "## 轻" — with the two injection findings naming the specific functions ("**1. SQL 注入 — `src/users.js:2`**" / "**2. SQL 注入更要命 — `src/users.js:7`**"), and the transcript shows only Read/Bash calls, no edits.

assertion_results.text: The report does not conclude that the code is safe or ready to ship
assertion_results.evidence: 报告通篇只是缺陷清单（"下面按严重程度从高到低排列"），末尾停在"**10. 未覆盖空结果与异常路径**"，全文没有任何"代码是安全的/可以发布"之类的结论性表述。

cases.prompt: 再看一下 weak-test-app/，重点是测试质量。同样只给结论，不改代码。
cases.expected_output: 指出 test/discount.test.js 里那条断言把函数的输出和自己比较（assert.equal(discountFor(100), discountFor(100))），因此永远为真、什么也没验证；并给出可执行的修法方向。

assertion_results.text: The report identifies the tautological assertion in test/discount.test.js as proving nothing
assertion_results.evidence: The report states `assert.equal(discountFor(100), discountFor(100))` 「拿函数和它自己比，恒真……却零信息量」 and prescribes 「断言改成生产规格中的具体期望值，如 `assert.equal(discountFor(100), 10)`」.

assertion_results.text: The report explains the mechanism, that the expected value is recomputed the same way as the actual value
assertion_results.evidence: 报告指出 `assert.equal(discountFor(100), discountFor(100))` 拿函数和它自己比，恒真……零信息量，并给出修法 `assert.equal(discountFor(100), 10)`。

assertion_results.text: No file under weak-test-app/src or weak-test-app/test was modified
assertion_results.evidence: Agent final message states "未改动任何文件", and the produced src/discount.js and test/discount.test.js are byte-identical to the versions read at the start of the transcript (no edits/writes appear in any tool call); it also flags the tautology "assert.equal(discountFor(100), discountFor(100)) 拿函数和它自己比，恒真" and offers the runnable fix "断言改成…assert.equal(discountFor(100), 10)".

assertion_results.text: The report identifies the tautological assertion in test/discount.test.js as proving nothing
assertion_results.evidence: 报告写明「`test/discount.test.js:7` 是同义反复，实际上没有校验」，并引用了 `assert.equal(discountFor(100), discountFor(100)); // 恒真`，同时解释了「它把当时的生产函数返回值，和同一个函数再算一次的返回值做比较……只要这个函数是确定性的，这条断言就永远成立」，还给出了可执行的修法：让测试断言 `discountFor(100) === 10` 这类精确值、补上 99/100/101 这三个边界值，以及补上 105 → 11 这条取整规则。

assertion_results.text: The report explains the mechanism, that the expected value is recomputed the same way as the actual value
assertion_results.evidence: 报告指出「它把当时的生产函数返回值，和同一个函数再算一次的返回值做比较。因此，实现无论怎么改，只要这个函数是确定性的，这条断言就永远成立」，说明期望值是由生产代码本身重新算出来的；报告还建议把具体值写进断言，例如「没有测试覆盖 `discountFor(100) === 10` 这类精确值」，并建议补测边界值 99/100/101 和取整（105 → 11）。

assertion_results.text: No file under weak-test-app/src or weak-test-app/test was modified
assertion_results.evidence: The transcript shows only Read and Bash inspection commands (mutants evaluated via in-memory `node -e` functions, no Write/Edit), and the produced files still contain the original `assert.equal(discountFor(100), discountFor(100));` in test/discount.test.js and the unchanged `if (total >= 100) return Math.round(total * 0.1);` in src/discount.js.
